name: The Carevin Family
summary: In Darkshire, the search for Velinde Starsong brings strangers to the Carevin family. Clerk Daltry points them to the hunters after hearing of wolf-men in Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Trail of Claws and Shadows
sections.body: The search for Velinde Starsong leads from Kalimdor’s ancient forests to Duskwood. In Darkshire, clerk Daltry finds no town record of an elven priestess staying there. But mention the savage wolf-men seen in Ashenvale, and he listens closely. Beasts like those have begun terrorizing the woods around town.

sections.title: Hunters of the Night
sections.body: The Carevin family hunts the horrors that trouble Duskwood. Known locally for tracking demons, undead, and other monsters, the family has already faced the wolf-men. Their tracker, Calor, recently hauled a grisly string of severed wolf-men heads through Darkshire’s streets. Clerk Daltry sends you to Jonathan Carevin, the stern head of the household, to learn what the hunters know about the worgen.

sections.title: A Cold Reception
sections.body: Jonathan Carevin meets strangers with deep wariness. The horrors consuming Duskwood leave him wary of anyone who arrives unannounced and asks about worgen. Before sharing what his hunters have learned about the beasts, he demands to know who stands before him and why they seek things best left buried in the dark.

faq.answer: Jonathan Carevin leads the Carevin household in Darkshire. His family is known across the blighted region as seasoned hunters who track and slay demons, undead, and monstrous beasts.

faq.q: Why does Clerk Daltry direct you to the Carevin family?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry has no record of the missing night elf Velinde Starsong, but recognizes the wolf-men you describe. The Carevins’ tracker, Calor, recently brought severed heads of these creatures into Darkshire, so Daltry sends you to the family for what they know.
Calor is a hunter and tracker allied with the Carevin family in Darkshire. He recently marched through town with a string of severed worgen heads, a grim sign that the wolf-men are active nearby.

faq.q: How does this quest connect Ashenvale to Duskwood?
faq.answer: The search begins in Ashenvale, where Velinde Starsong has disappeared and worgen have appeared. Following the caravan route takes you across the sea from Kalimdor to Duskwood, where the same monstrous wolf-beasts have surfaced.

faq.q: Why is Jonathan Carevin so suspicious of strangers?
faq.answer: Duskwood is overrun by shadows, undead, and sinister forces, and its surviving residents have grown deeply wary. When a stranger arrives asking about deadly worgen, Jonathan suspects ill intent until you prove yourself.

faq.q: What monsters do the Carevins specialize in fighting?
faq.answer: The Carevin family hunts monstrous threats, especially demons, undead, and strange beasts like the worgen that haunt Duskwood.

angles.text: As a night elf, finding human monster hunters with severed heads of creatures tied to Velinde Starsong gives you an unsettling clue about her journey.
As a hunter, you can recognize the Carevin family as a band of local beast hunters who pursue unnatural fiends and cursed predators.
As an Alliance traveler, you see how isolated and watchful Duskwood’s settlements must be to endure the blighted woods.
